meta.title: Honey It's Handled, the plan
meta.desc: The plan beside the new Honey It's Handled site. The couples marrying in 2027 and 2028, when they choose a planner, who else they see, and the first 90 days. Prepared by Astra, October 2026.

cover.by: Prepared by Astra for Elise Laeven, October 2026
cover.h: The couples marrying in 2027 are choosing their planner now.
cover.lede: You need a handful of them. The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024. This plan is what those couples compare before they write to anyone, when they decide, the site we've sketched so they can see a wedding planned your way, and what we'd do in the first 90 days.

today.h: Your brand is ready. A couple can't see a wedding on the site yet.
today.lede: We read every page of honeyitshandled.com this morning while you were editing it. Since today the Events page tells two nights, Cinco Cero and the Pro League Awards '26, and Jan Geysen calls working with you "amazing, from the initial meeting to the end of the party". Weddings have their own page with your three ways of working and the launch offer for 2027 and 2028. What a couple planning a wedding can't find yet is one wedding, told from the first call to the final dance.

market.h: The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.
market.lede: Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.
market.abroad_line: Another 4,390 marriages of people living in Belgium were registered abroad in 2024, 9% of Belgium's 48,589. Statbel counts weddings in embassies and consulates in Belgium in that line too. Destination weddings are on your form already.
market.src: Statbel, Marriages in 2024, the workbook and the web page (news of 12 March 2026), read 26 Oct 2026. Counted by the place of marriage, every marriage with at least one partner living in Belgium. Statistiek Vlaanderen gives 27,100 for Flanders (16 July 2026). Flowerytales' ceiling from flowerytales.be.

calendar.h: Nine in ten 2027 weddings are already inside the year Wedding Dreamworx asks for.
calendar.lede: Wedding Dreamworx asks couples for at least a year and would rather have eighteen months. Blossoms Together's planning timeline starts eighteen months out. In House of Weddings' 2025 survey, couples planning now expect to be engaged for 17.7 months, and two in three start planning the moment they're engaged. Pick the year and how far ahead couples book, and the months that have reached that point by today turn red.

All read 26 Oct 2026. A wedding's booking month is its month minus the months ahead. It counts as reached when that's October 2026 or earlier.

rivals.h: Three of the four tell weddings by name. The fourth started eleven months before you.
rivals.lede: We opened four Antwerp planners a couple would compare you with, three of them in Wilrijk. Wedding Dreamworx tells nine weddings and quotes seven couples. Flowerytales tells four and publishes a price. Salon Weddings tells nineteen, and last November it announced it's stopping. Its post names a 2026 that stayed "té stil" and too many weekends away from home. Bliss Weddings, registered in February 2025, has one couple's words and a stand at Trouw & Trends in February.

money.h: Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.
money.lede: That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. Move the budget and see what Wedding Dreamworx's rule of thumb makes of it.

why.h: The next four months are when 2027 and 2028 couples go looking.
why.lede: After May, December and September are the most popular months to propose, and two in three couples start planning right away. The wedding fairs around Antwerp run from next Sunday to the end of February.

behind.p: Salon Weddings, 95 couples since 2017, says it's stopping. A planner with 9,909 followers on Instagram is leaving the market.
Statbel, weddings up 4.3% in Belgium and 6.7% in Flanders in 2024.
Blossoms Together launches a planning tool for couples who'd rather not hire a planner. A site that shows the months a planner takes off their hands is the answer to it.

built.h: The site we sketched treats every couple as one of your first.
built.lede: It opens on a wedding film and your own line, “For the moments you’ll never want to forget.” Then your launch offer, and your three colours as one couple’s day, something off white for the first idea, something blue for the planning you carry, something red for the day itself. It ends on a reply card that arrives already written, with their names, date, guests and the help they want. The wedding films are stand ins until your first couples are filmed, which is what your launch offer asks for.

first.h: Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same reply card.
first.lede: Your form already asks how people found you. These are the answers it offers, plus the launch offer itself, which is the one channel nobody else in Antwerp has this year.

channels.fact: 56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.
channels.do: Post the new site one colour at a time, off white, blue and red, and keep telling nights the way you told Cinco Cero, a sign, a setting, a night.
channels.n: Visits from Instagram that reach the reply card

channels.fact: 65.3% of the same couples use it, more than any other source. Your home page already speaks it, "a Pinterest board with 847 pins".
channels.do: Make a board for every page of the new site and every event, each pin linking back to the date question.
channels.n: Saves and clicks to the site

channels.fact: The second answer on your form.
channels.do: Give weddings in Antwerp and destination weddings a page each, and put Jan's words where couples check before they write.
channels.n: Searches that land on a wedding page

channels.fact: House of Weddings, used by 65% of the couples it surveyed, lists only planners with its label. In exceptional cases it lets a newcomer in, when several label partners who've worked with her vouch for her. Good online reviews are a condition for everyone.
channels.do: Walk Marry Me Mechelen this Sunday and Het Bruidsparadijs in January, decide on a stand for Trouw & Trends, and ask the suppliers you work with about the label.

channels.fact: 125 guests saw Cinco Cero and 570+ the Pro League Awards. Bliss Weddings' only quote is from a couple who'd seen Lissa work at a family wedding.
channels.do: Put a card in your red envelope for every guest list you handle, with the new site on it.

channels.fact: Your offer already trades a discount for the right to capture and share the celebration.
channels.do: Tell each first couple's year on the site as it happens, with their yes in writing, so the couples of 2028 meet a wedding planned your way.
